matched.condition: Same total pips, number of producing resources, and adjacent hex count

methods.policy: Frozen Generation37, no search, one original greedy trajectory per board.
methods.fitting: Original whole-board 80k/20k split, within-decision-centered legal logits; equal board weight; train-RMS standardized ridge alpha .001. Baseline is previous board-scarcity/context specification. Exact dependencies removed using train data.
methods.uncertainty: Whole-board normal/delta-method95% intervals. Coefficient sandwich includes uncertainty in RMS scaling, conditional on retained feature set. Held-out R² uncertainty conditions on fitted coefficients. Descriptive comparisons use paired board means.
methods.fallback: For each A1, exactly minimize the best remaining legal A2 over all legal B1/B2 settlement pairs. Two objectives: total pips; lexicographic combined resource coverage then total pips. Closed neighborhoods encode the actual setup settlement rule. Roads do not change setup settlement availability; every valid settlement configuration admits incident starting roads.
methods.fast_exact: A pair that removes the best complement must contain a blocker in its closed neighborhood. Its second blocker must remove the best site surviving the first blocker. Checking these <=4x4 pairs attains the same optimum as full enumeration. Independently validated against every legal pair for200 cases.
methods.denial: At B2, compute damage to A2 availability after the candidate: count/sum of other removed corners, loss of the best remaining pip total and best resource coverage paired with A1, count of removed upper-quartile production sites. These are availability proxies, not estimates of opponent win probability.
methods.limitation: Correlations and proxy robustness do not establish strategic intent, optimal play, or advantage in actual continuation games. Tight intervals do not include uncertainty over trained policies.
